name: AI Barrister Flight Simulator
description: The AI Barrister Flight Simulator is a neuro-symbolic benchmark that evaluates large language models' structured legal reasoning by testing their ability to reason over legal structures such as statutes, case law, and citation networks. It includes five task families and four structure-aware metrics to expose failure modes beyond accuracy.
reputation: A niche but notable legal-reasoning benchmark from recent neuro-symbolic LLM evaluation work, with interest mainly in the legal AI and structured reasoning communities.
notes: Includes a Legal Knowledge Graph and symbolic controller; evaluates multi-hop citation, jurisdiction constraints, temporal validity, doctrine structure, and multi-query consistency; uses metrics like Constraint Violation Rate and Hallucination Rate.
